content: If the TTL Timer of a Client Service expires, the Service Discovery module shall perform the following steps: • Enter the Initial Wait Phase and indicate the state SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_ DOWN to the BswM by calling the API BswM_Sd_ClientServiceCurrentState (). • All subscribed Eventgroups of this Client Service shall expired in this instance (stop TTL timer) and the expiration shall be handled as describe in SWS_ SD_00601.
